breadcrumb: Std 9 Social Science (English) — Economics Unit 5: Migration — Boxed notes (தெரிந்து தெளிவோம் / Do you know)

questions.quote: In any settlement - village or town - change in population occurs due to birth, death and migration. Of these three components of population change, birth and death is clearly identifiable events while migration poses the maximum amount of problem with regards to its definition and measurement.

en.q: Which of the three components of population change poses the maximum problem in definition and measurement?
en.explanation: Birth and death are clearly identifiable events.

ta.q: மக்கள்தொகை மாற்றத்தின் மூன்று கூறுகளில் வரையறுப்பதிலும் அளவிடுவதிலும் மிகுதிச் சிக்கலைத் தருவது
ta.explanation: பிறப்பும் இறப்பும் தெளிவாக அடையாளம் காணத்தக்க நிகழ்வுகள்.

questions.quote: In the Census of India, migration is enumerated on two bases (i) Place of birth: If the place of birth is different from the place of enumeration (known as life-time migrant). (ii) Place of residence: If the place of last residence is different from the place of enumeration (known as migrant, by place of last residence).

en.q: A person whose place of birth is different from the place of enumeration is known as a
options: migrant by place of last residence
en.explanation: The second basis is the place of last residence.

ta.q: பிறந்த இடம் கணக்கெடுக்கப்படும் இடத்திலிருந்து வேறுபடுவோர் எவ்வாறு அழைக்கப்படுகின்றனர்?

questions.quote: In Tamil Nadu out of 7.2 crore people, 3.13 crore people were counted as migrants, in 2011. That is, the percentage of migrants was 37 percent in the country, while it was at a much higher rate in Tamil Nadu at 43 percent.

en.q: According to the textbook, in 2011 the percentage of migrants was 37% in India and ______ in Tamil Nadu.
en.explanation: In Tamil Nadu 3.13 crore of 7.2 crore people were migrants.

ta.explanation: தமிழ்நாட்டின் 7.2 கோடி மக்களில் 3.13 கோடி பேர் இடம்பெயர்ந்தவர்கள்.

questions.quote: However, we find that in India as well as Tamil Nadu, the extent of migration is much higher in rural areas compared to urban areas. In 2011, 37 percent... rural... urban India is 27 percent. In Tamil Nadu, migrants account for 41 percent in rural areas and 35 percent in urban areas.

en.q: According to the textbook, in Tamil Nadu migrants account for ______ in rural areas and ______ in urban areas (2011).
en.explanation: The mobility of population in rural areas is greater than in urban areas.

questions.quote: In the country as a whole, 53 percent are female migrants while 23 percent are male migrants, in 2011. In Tamil Nadu, ... more than half the females (52%) ... and 35 percent are male migrants.

en.q: According to the textbook, in 2011 about ______ of all females in India were counted as migrants.
en.explanation: Male migrants were 23% in India; in Tamil Nadu 52% of females and 35% of males were migrants.

ta.q: பாடநூலின்படி, 2011இல் இந்தியாவிலுள்ள மொத்தப் பெண்களில் ஏறத்தாழ ______ பேர் புலம்பெயர்ந்தோராகக் கணக்கிடப்பட்டனர்.

questions.quote: 70 percent in India and 51 percent in Tamil Nadu report marriage as the reason for migration of females in 2011. ... Of all the male migrants in India, 28 percent report 'work' as the major reason for their migration, in 2011. The corresponding percentage in Tamil Nadu is 26 percent.

en.q:
Match List I with List II.
List I: a) Marriage as reason for female migration in India  b) Marriage as reason for female migration in Tamil Nadu  c) Work as reason for male migration in India  d) Work as reason for male migration in Tamil Nadu
List II: 1) 70%  2) 51%  3) 26%  4) 28%
en.explanation: Movement for work is the driving force for migration among men.

ta.q:
பட்டியல் I-ஐ பட்டியல் II உடன் பொருத்துக.
பட்டியல் I: அ) இந்தியாவில் பெண்கள் இடம்பெயர திருமணம் காரணம்  ஆ) தமிழ்நாட்டில் பெண்கள் இடம்பெயர திருமணம் காரணம்  இ) இந்தியாவில் ஆண்கள் இடம்பெயர வேலை காரணம்  ஈ) தமிழ்நாட்டில் ஆண்கள் இடம்பெயர வேலை காரணம்
பட்டியல் II: 1) 70%  2) 51%  3) 26%  4) 28%

questions.quote: To sum up, in Tamil Nadu, two out of every five persons is reported to be a migrant in the year 2011. Incidence of migrants is higher in rural areas and larger among women.

en.q: In Tamil Nadu in 2011, how many out of every five persons were reported to be migrants?
en.explanation: Incidence of migration is higher in rural areas and larger among women.

ta.q: 2011இல் தமிழ்நாட்டில் ஒவ்வொரு ஐந்து நபர்களில் எத்தனை பேர் இடம்பெயர்ந்தவர்கள்?

questions.quote: During the colonial period, labourers had moved to other colonies seeking work and wages. In the more recent period workers from Tamil Nadu have been moving to countries in the Gulf, United States of America and Australia. In 2015, an independent research study was conducted...

en.q: In recent times, workers from Tamil Nadu have been moving mainly to
options: Gulf countries, the USA and Australia
en.explanation: During the colonial period labourers moved to other colonies seeking work and wages.

ta.q: சமீப காலத்தில் தமிழ்நாட்டுத் தொழிலாளர்கள் பெரும்பாலும் செல்லும் இடங்கள்
ta.explanation: காலனிக் காலத்தில் வேலைக்காக பிற காலனிகளுக்குச் சென்றனர்.

questions.quote: Of the international migrants, 15 percent are women, while 85 percent are men.

en.q: Among the international migrants from Tamil Nadu, the share of women is

questions.quote: On the question of educational qualifications of migrants from Tamil Nadu, the study reveals that in 2015 about 7% were illiterates; 30% have completed Class X; 10% have completed Class XII; 15% had undergone vocational training; 11% were graduates; 12% were professionally qualified and 11% had Post Graduate degrees.

en.q: Which educational category formed the largest group among Tamil Nadu's migrants in 2015?
en.explanation: The study reveals highly skilled, semi-skilled and low skilled occupations.

ta.q: 2015 ஆய்வில் தமிழகத்தின் இடம்பெயர்ந்தோரில் மிகப்பெரிய கல்வித் தகுதிப் பிரிவு
ta.explanation: உயர் திறன், அரைத்திறன், குறைதிறன் பணிகளில் உள்ளனர்.

questions.quote: The extent and nature of migration in any society is basically determined by the nature of the development process experienced by that society. Poorer sections of the population migrate as a survival strategy... Migrants from better-off sections migrate to improve their living standards.

en.q: The extent and nature of migration in any society is basically determined by
options: the nature of the development process experienced by that society
en.explanation: The type and scale of development achieved by agriculture and industry determine migratory patterns.

ta.q: ஒரு சமூகத்தின் இடம்பெயர்வின் அளவையும் தன்மையையும் அடிப்படையில் தீர்மானிப்பது
ta.explanation: வேளாண், தொழில் துறை வளர்ச்சியின் வகையும் அளவும் இடம்பெயர்வு முறைகளைத் தீர்மானிக்கின்றன.

questions.quote: To reduce the volume of migration: ... Rural development policies to reduce poverty and insecurity would be essential. To redirect the migrant streams: Redirection of migrant streams away from big metropolitan cities is a desirable policy option.

en.q: Redirecting migrant streams away from big metropolitan cities can help reduce spatial inequalities by
options: developing a more dispersed pattern of urbanisation
en.explanation: Rural development policies are essential to reduce the volume of migration.

ta.q: பெருநகரங்களிலிருந்து இடம்பெயர்வு ஓட்டங்களைத் திசை திருப்புவது இடஞ்சார்ந்த ஏற்றத்தாழ்வைக் குறைக்கும்; அது
ta.explanation: கிராமப்புற வளர்ச்சிக் கொள்கைகள் இடம்பெயர்வின் அளவைக் குறைக்க அவசியம்.
